name: Frédéric Chopin — Poesia ao Piano
description: Pianist Nikolay Pestov performs a recital of Frédéric Chopin's works, including ballads, waltzes, preludes, nocturnes, and the Fantaisie-Impromptu. The performance explores the emotional depth of the Romantic composer's music.
longDescription:
Pianist Nikolay Pestov presents a recital titled "Frédéric Chopin, Poesia ao Piano" at Open Music School Porto. The program features some of Chopin's most recognized compositions, such as his ballads, waltzes, preludes, nocturnes, and the famous Fantaisie-Impromptu.

The recital aims to guide the audience through the intimate, lyrical, and emotionally intense aspects of Chopin's work, highlighting his significance as a major Romantic composer.

The event is scheduled for November 1, 2026, starting at 7:00 PM. Tickets are priced at €15, and the event is suitable for ages 6 and up. The venue is located at R. de Júlio Dinis, 580, Porto.
descriptionPt: O pianista Nikolay Pestov apresenta um recital de obras de Frédéric Chopin, incluindo baladas, valsas, prelúdios, noturnos e a Fantaisie-Impromptu. A atuação explora a profundidade emocional da música do compositor romântico.
